_description: Step E Llama3 fixture: multi-turn user/assistant (2 exchanges). Verifies multi-turn rendering through dispatch -> Llama3Encoder -> tokenize_with_hf_template. No thinking (Llama3 has no native thinking protocol), no tools, no tool_calls, no system. The point is to exercise Llama3's per-message header (<|start_header_id|>...<|end_header_id|>) and EOT delimiters across turns.

expected.notes: No known Jinja quirk for plain multi-turn on Llama3. M3 token-first builder must match jinja bit-for-bit including header/EOT delimiters.
